import unittest
from tasks import agregar_tarea, completar_tarea, pendientes

class TestTasks(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_agregar_tarea(self):
        tareas = []
        tarea = agregar_tarea(tareas, "Leer capítulo")
        self.assertEqual(tarea["titulo"], "Leer capítulo")
        self.assertFalse(tarea["completada"])

    def test_completar_tarea(self):
        tareas = []
        agregar_tarea(tareas, "Practicar")
        completar_tarea(tareas, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(pendientes(tareas)), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
